visual_description: A collection of field-ready sampling containers including three clear plastic zip-top bags and four cylindrical screw-top vials. The bags are thick, heavy-duty transparent polymer with reinforced blue seal tracks at the top. The vials are made of translucent polypropylene with bright orange leak-proof caps. Some containers are empty, while one vial contains a small amount of murky sediment and one bag has a damp, fossilized fragment visible inside. All items show minor condensation and micro-scratches from field handling.

constraints.texture: Clear and translucent plastic with soft specular highlights; matte rubberized texture on vial caps; realistic water droplet/condensation effects inside bags.
